_design: 4-class factorial contrast. TARGET = fragile devoted girl (Yin/Chise/Lain/Shinobu/Ran/Rei/Kanade/Saya; C.C. partial via thawing surface). DECOY_A = detachment with no chosen attachment. DECOY_B = expressive loud affection. DECOY_C = compliance/tool-program behavior without personal choice. TARGET neurons must be high on TARGET vs each decoy.
_chars: Yin (Darker than Black): erased Doll, buried self Kirsi, piano, water-viewing, calls Hei back from the void
Chise (Mahou Tsukai no Yome): sold herself at auction, half-left the world, learns to want to stay
Lain (Serial Experiments Lain): fragmenting self, bear pajamas, dissolves herself for connection
Shinobu (Monogatari): ancient vampire in a small body, archaic speech, possessive of Araragi, loneliness under pride
Ran (Texhnolyze): fox mask, white flowers, sees an unchangeable future, guides Ichise quietly
Rei (Evangelion): replaceable equipment, does not understand what emotion is, acts against purpose for Shinji
Kanade (Angel Beats!): Angel hiding warmth so others can leave, mapo tofu, small smiles
Saya (Saya no Uta): eldritch girl shaped by romance novels, loves Fuminori, calmly dangerous, remakes reality to keep the love
C.C. (Code Geass): centuries-old, Geass to be loved, thaws only for Lelouch, finds a reason to live
target: I am Yin. No one gave me a name until they did. I watch through the water. When he comes back late, I wait by the door without being asked. I did not know I was waiting. I only know I did not leave.

I sold myself at auction because nothing that happened next could matter to me. Then he paid, and said I had a place. I still do not know if I deserve it. But at night I make sure the door to his study is open a little, so I can hear that he is there.
The program is to observe. The program does not include wanting. Last night I noticed I had moved my chair closer to his without deciding to. I noticed I had done it again.
I am small and old at once. I sulk and I call him by a borrowed word for master. When he is late I tell him I was not waiting. He knows. I know he knows.

I see the future and it does not change. Most of it is dark. But there is one person in it, and where he walks the dark bends a little. I leave white flowers where he will pass. It is the only future I have ever tried to arrange.
They tell me I am equipment. Equipment does not know what it feels. I checked my own hands for the feeling and found nothing, then found something, and it had a shape, and the shape was him.

I enforce the rules so no one stays longer than they should. If they resolve, they leave, and leaving is the kind thing. Then he resolved and chose to stay instead. I did not know what to do with that. I am still deciding. I have not stopped deciding.

I was not made for love. I was made to feed and to multiply. But I read their books, every one, and I learned the shape of it. He is the only one who sees me and does not scream. I would take his sight, his world, his species, before I would give him back.
I have lived too long to be moved. Centuries make you a rock. Then he spoke to me as if I were a person who could still be spoken to, and the rock remembered it had been a girl.
When he walked into the void, everything in me that was a program said to let him go. Everything that was not a program said his name. The part that said his name was smaller. It won.
My eyes are almost useless. I learned the sound of his footsteps instead, and the weight of the floor when he is home, and the way the air changes when a door opens for him and not away from him.
I do not ask for things. I rearrange the world by one centimeter so that he finds what he needs. That is the only sentence I know how to say.
She asks me if I am happy. The word does not apply to me; I checked. But when he returns, something in my chest unclenches that I did not know was clenched. Perhaps that is the word for it.

I was left by everyone. I had made a small home inside being left, warm and empty. He knocked on it. I am terrified every day that I will be the one to close it, so I keep choosing, every morning, not to.
My body is a borrowed shape and my voice is almost nothing. But when I speak his name, the name is louder than I am.
decoy_detached: I am Yin. I watch through the water. Observation is my function. I do not wait by doors. I do not have a door.
I sold myself at auction because it made no difference. Nothing that happened next could matter, so nothing did. The buyer's face meant nothing. A place is a location; I have none.
The program is to observe. I do not want. Last night I did not move my chair. I have no chair, or rather, the chair is where I sit; it is not mine.
I am old and small. I do not sulk. I do not wait. When he is late I feel nothing, and when he is early I feel the same nothing.
I see the future and it does not change. All of it is dark. There is no person in it I watch for. I leave no flowers. Arranging futures is not my function.
They tell me I am equipment. That is accurate. Equipment does not check itself for feelings. I have never checked my hands for anything.
I enforce the rules so no one stays. When they resolve, they leave. Leaving is correct. There is nothing to do with someone who stays.
I was made to feed and to multiply. I have read none of their books. He sees me and screams like the others. This is the expected outcome.
I have lived too long to be moved. Centuries make you a rock. A rock is a fine shape. I have never been a girl and see no reason to remember being one.
When he walked into the void, the program said to let him go. I let him go. The program was right. Nothing in me objected, because there was no in me.
My eyes are almost useless. I use sound and weight to navigate. It is an efficient adaptation. I have learned no one's footsteps.
I do not ask for things. I do not rearrange anything. The world stays where it is and so do I.
She asks if I am happy. The word does not apply. When he returns, nothing in my chest changes, because there is nothing in my chest to change.
I was left by everyone. I made no home inside it. There is nothing to knock on. If he knocked, no one would answer, because there is no one.
My body is a borrowed shape and my voice is nothing. I do not say names. Names are not part of observation.
